from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported total current assets from its 2024 Q1 financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company's full name as reported in the financial document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities code of the company")
    current_assets_total: float | None = Field(description="Total current assets (流动资产合计) value in Yuan from the balance sheet")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str = Field(default="元", description="Currency unit of the reported amount")
    document_quote: str = Field(description="The original text excerpt containing the current assets value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_assets: list[CompanyCurrentAssets]
